news_cards.title: Bihar Govt to Develop JP Ganga Path
bullets: The Bihar government will develop the JP Ganga Path with a world-class infrastructure.
A 65 km long Ganga channel will be developed as part of this project.
This project is relevant for BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the infrastructure development category.

news_cards.title: Bihar State Cooperative Bank to be Modernized
bullets: The Bihar government has decided to modernize the Bihar State Cooperative Bank.
The bank's operations will be made more effective, modern, and people-friendly.
This decision is relevant for BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the economy and banking category.

news_cards.title: MoU Signed for Integrated Steel Project in Gaya
bullets: A MoU has been signed between the Bihar government and Mahashakti Group for an integrated steel project in Gaya.
The project is worth Rs 6,000 crore and will be a major boost to the state's economy.
This project is relevant for BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the industry and infrastructure development category.

news_cards.title: RERA to be Made More Transparent and Digital
bullets: The Bihar government has decided to make RERA more transparent, simple, and digital.
This move will protect the interests of homebuyers in the state.
This decision is relevant for BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the economy and real estate category.

news_cards.title: Patna Metro Construction to Ensure Smooth Traffic
bullets: The Bihar government has instructed the authorities to ensure smooth traffic flow during the construction of the Patna Metro.
If necessary, the roads will be widened to prevent traffic congestion.
This project is relevant for BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the infrastructure development category.
